# History Rewrite (2026-10-17)

On 2026-10-17, history was rewritten to remove details that don't belong in a
public repository: a real person's name and other terms copied from the
owner's library, plus the owner's host names, LAN addresses, domain, GPU IDs
and home-directory paths. `git filter-repo --replace-text` changed only those
strings. Files, images and commit messages are otherwise unchanged. The
replacements are placeholders: `example.com`, the documentation address range
`192.0.2.0/24`, `gpu-host`, `alexandria-host` and `proxy-host`.

Commits from before the first affected one kept their hashes, including
`45eb491`, which Hosting pins in `go.mod`. Docs and deploy evidence written
before the rewrite cite the old hashes; look one up below (old → new, first 12
characters). Deploy image tags such as `2a30efe-batch1` keep their old names.
The next app-only deploy diffs against the **new** hash of the last deployed
commit (for `2a30efe-batch1`, that's `a2b10a66c633`).
